item.title: Shopify moves back to Native from React Native
item.description: Coding agents changed what it costs to build mobile apps twice. Here’s why Shopify is moving from React Native back to Swift and Kotlin. (4 sources: hackernews, lobsters, reactstatus, rprogramming)

item.description: We're joining Shopify to give Tailwind a stable long-term home where it will be actively maintained for the millions of people who depend on it. (5 sources: frontendfocus, hackernews, nodeweekly, reactstatus, rubyweekly)
